about.title: About Maison Nura
about.body: Maison Nura is a Doha florist house rooted in quiet luxury—editorial arrangements, enduring plants, and thoughtful gifts for life in Qatar. We source seasonally, design with restraint, and deliver with care from our studio to your door.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: For styling advice, corporate gifting, or event florals, reach our team in Doha.
contact.name: Your name

carePage.title: Flower care
carePage.body: Fresh stems thrive in cool rooms away from direct AC. Trim stems, refresh water often, and keep fruit at a distance. For plants, bright indirect light and measured watering suit most Qatar homes. Each Maison Nura piece includes specific care on the card.

legal.privacyBody: We use your details only to fulfil orders and respond to enquiries. We do not sell personal data. Delivery partners receive the minimum information required to complete your gift.
legal.termsBody: All prices are in QAR. Perishable goods are prepared fresh; timing may vary during peak occasions. By placing an order you agree to our delivery windows and substitution policy for seasonal availability.
